content: passlib is unmaintained (last release ~3 years old) and breaks on Python 3.13 (crypt module removal) plus a known incompatibility with bcrypt>=4.1 __about__ removal. pwdlib (by frankie567, the fastapi-users maintainer) is the modern replacement, used by fastapi-users itself; PasswordHash.recommended() defaults to Argon2 with bcrypt fallback for verification. OWASP also recommends argon2id over bcrypt for new projects.
